en: The peregrine falcon dives at over 320 kilometers per hour, making it much faster than the cheetah, which runs at only 112 kilometers per hour.
Methuselah, a Great Basin bristlecone pine tree, is over 4,800 years old, which is about sixty times longer than the average human lifespan.
A single drop of human blood contains about five million red blood cells, vastly outnumbering the roughly ten thousand white blood cells in the same drop.
There are approximately 2.5 million ants for every single human on Earth, meaning the total global ant population is roughly twenty quadrillion individuals.
The coco de mer produces the world's largest seed, weighing up to 42 kilograms, while orchid seeds are so tiny that one ounce contains millions.
A human baby is born with about 270 bones, but adults have only 206 because many smaller bones fuse together as the child grows.
A blue whale's heart beats only about ten times per minute when diving, whereas a mouse's heart beats a rapid 500 to 600 times per minute.
A single giant sequoia tree can weigh over 2,000 tonnes, which is heavier than three hundred adult African elephants combined.
A single female cane toad can lay up to 30,000 eggs in one clutch, whereas a typical dog gives birth to only about six puppies.
The Philippine eagle has a wingspan of up to two meters, which is longer than the height of an average ten-year-old child.
If uncoiled, the DNA in all the cells of one human body would stretch about 10 billion miles, far beyond the orbit of Pluto.
The Arctic tern migrates up to 70,000 kilometers annually, flying a distance equivalent to traveling around the Earth's equator almost twice.
